title: Books, instructions and information
intro: A story entertains. Instructions help a reader do something. Information gives facts and a recount tells an experience. Look for titles, lists, labels and pictures that help the reader find something.
support: کیسه، لارښوونې، معلومات او د پېښې بیان بېلې دندې لري. سرلیک، لړ، نښه او انځور وګورئ.
text:
Grow a Bean
You need: a bean, a pot, soil, water.
1. Put soil in the pot. 2. Plant the bean. 3. Add a little water.
Caption: A small shoot grows above the soil.
Recount: Yesterday I planted a bean. Today I saw a shoot.
model: The list says what to gather. The steps tell what to do. The caption describes what a picture shows. A contents page can point to headings. A recount tells what happened.
activity: Make a sign with two steps for putting a name label on a cup.
adult: Give the learner a cup and paper. Ask them to explain two steps for putting a label on the cup. Follow the steps as spoken, then discuss unclear details.

tasks: Point to the heading. Say what the reader will learn to do.
Copy three items from the You need list.
Sketch a young plant. Put English labels on the shoot and soil.
Find the title, cover and contents of a real book. Say what each helps you do.
Copy the steps in order, then read them to a partner.
Write two clear instructions for washing a cup. Add a heading.
Write a two-sentence recount of something you did yesterday.
Read the caption: Two leaves grow above the soil. What grows above the soil? Add a caption to your own plant drawing.
Write a heading, a materials list and two steps for getting a school bag ready.
Read: “Drop, drop, rain on the pot. / Drop, drop, that is a lot!” Compare it with: “Add a little water to the pot.” Which one guides a job? Explain.
